name: $aiChat
description: Send a message to an AI model. If a conversation ID is provided (or autoCreate is true), history is maintained. Returns the AI response.

args.name: prompt
args.description: The message to send.

args.name: convId
args.description: Conversation ID to continue. Pass empty to auto-create or use the current channel scope.

args.name: model
args.description: Model override in provider:model format, or a route name.

name: $aiChatRaw
description: One-shot AI chat with no conversation history. Every call is stateless.

args.name: prompt
args.description: The message to send.

args.name: model
args.description: Model in provider:model format, or a route name.

args.name: systemPrompt
args.description: Optional system prompt for this call only.

name: $aiLastConvId
description: Returns the conversation ID used in the most recent $aiChat call.

name: $aiLastModel
description: Returns the model that was actually used in the most recent $aiChat or $aiChatRaw call in this execution.

name: $aiLastTokens
description: Returns the total tokens used in the most recent AI call (input + output). Returns 0 if not tracked.

name: $aiClearConversation
description: Clears all messages in a conversation, keeping its settings.

args.name: convId
args.description: The ID of the conversation to clear.

name: $aiConvHistory
description: Returns the conversation history. format: "json" returns raw JSON, "text" returns a readable transcript.

args.name: convId
args.description: The ID of the conversation.

args.name: format
args.description: json or text. Default: json

name: $aiConvInfo
description: Returns a property of a conversation as a string. Properties: id, userID, guildID, channelID, model, systemPrompt, temperature, maxTokens, messageCount, createdAt, updatedAt

args.name: convId
args.description: The ID of the conversation.

args.name: property
args.description: The property of the conversation to return.

name: $aiDeleteAllConversations
description: Deletes all conversations for a user, guild, or both.

args.name: userId
args.description: The ID of the user.

args.name: guildId
args.description: The ID of the guild.

name: $aiDeleteConversation
description: Deletes a conversation and all its history.

args.name: convId
args.description: The ID of the conversation.

name: $aiGetConvId
description: Finds the most recent conversation for the given scope (user/guild/channel). Returns empty if none found.

args.name: userId
args.description: The ID of the user.

args.name: guildId
args.description: The ID of the guild.

args.name: channelId
args.description: The ID of the channel.

name: $aiNewConversation
description: Creates a new conversation and returns its ID.

args.name: userId
args.description: Scope the conversation to a user. Defaults to command author.

args.name: guildId
args.description: Scope the conversation to a guild. Defaults to current guild.

args.name: channelId
args.description: Scope the conversation to a channel. Defaults to current channel.

name: $aiSetConvModel
description: Sets the model for a specific conversation.

args.name: convId
args.description: The ID of the conversation.

args.name: model
args.description: The model to use for the conversation.

name: $aiSetConvSystemPrompt
description: Sets the system prompt for a specific conversation.

args.name: convId
args.description: The ID of the conversation.

args.name: systemPrompt
args.description: The system prompt for the conversation.

name: $aiSetConvTemperature
description: Sets the temperature (0-2) for a specific conversation.

args.name: convId
args.description: The ID of the conversation.

args.name: temperature
args.description: The temperature (0-2) for the conversation.

name: $aiMcpAddServer
description: Register a new MCP server at runtime.

args.name: id
args.description: Unique server ID.

args.name: url
args.description: MCP server HTTP endpoint.

args.name: apiKey
args.description: Optional API key.

name: $aiMcpCallTool
description: Directly call an MCP tool and return its result.

args.name: serverId
args.description: The ID of the server.

args.name: toolName
args.description: The name of the tool to call.

args.name: args
args.description: Tool arguments as a JSON string.

name: $aiMcpDisableServer
description: Disable a registered MCP server without removing it.

args.name: id
args.description: The ID of the server.

name: $aiMcpEnableServer
description: Enable a registered MCP server.

args.name: id
args.description: The ID of the server.

name: $aiMcpFetchTools
description: Fetches and caches tools from all enabled MCP servers. Returns count.

args.name: serverId
args.description: Fetch from a specific server only.

name: $aiMcpListServers
description: Returns all registered MCP servers as JSON.

name: $aiMcpListTools
description: Returns cached MCP tools as a JSON array.

args.name: serverId
args.description: The ID of the server to fetch tools from.

name: $aiMcpRemoveServer
description: Remove a registered MCP server.

args.name: id
args.description: The ID of the server to remove.

name: $aiGetRoute
description: Returns the model list for a named route as a JSON array.

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the route to get models for.

name: $aiListModels
description: Lists available models for a provider. Returns JSON array.

args.name: providerId
args.description: The ID of the provider to list models for.

name: $aiListProviders
description: Returns all registered provider IDs joined by separator.

args.name: separator
args.description: The separator to use for joining provider IDs.

name: $aiListRoutes
description: Returns all named routes as JSON.

name: $aiRemoveRoute
description: Removes a named model route.

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the route to remove.

name: $aiSetRoute
description: Define or update a named model route. Models are tried in order on failure.

args.name: name
args.description: Route name, e.g. "fast" or "myRoute".

args.name: models
args.description: Model strings in order, e.g. openai:gpt-4o-mini; anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5

name: $aiRagAdd
description: Add a document to the local RAG store.

args.name: content
args.description: The document content.

args.name: namespace
args.description: Namespace to group documents. Default: "default".

name: $aiRagAddBatch
description: Add multiple documents at once separated by a delimiter.

args.name: content
args.description: All documents joined by separator.

args.name: separator
args.description: Separator between documents. Default: newline.

args.name: namespace
args.description: Namespace to add documents to. Default: "default".

name: $aiRagClear
description: Delete all documents in a namespace.

args.name: namespace
args.description: Namespace to delete documents from. Default: "default".

name: $aiRagCount
description: Returns the number of documents in the RAG store, optionally filtered by namespace.

args.name: namespace
args.description: Namespace to count documents in. Default: "default".

name: $aiRagDelete
description: Delete a RAG document by its ID.

args.name: id
args.description: The ID of the document to delete.

name: $aiRagNamespaces
description: Returns all RAG namespaces joined by separator.

args.name: separator
args.description: Separator for joining namespace IDs. Default: ", "

name: $aiRagSearch
description: Search the RAG store and return matching document contents joined by separator.

args.name: query
args.description: The query to search for.

args.name: namespace
args.description: The namespace to search in.

args.name: topK
args.description: The number of results to return. Default: 5.

args.name: separator
args.description: Default: \n---\n

name: $aiGetUserSetting
description: Get a user AI setting. Keys: model, systemPrompt, temperature, maxHistory, maxTokens

args.name: key
args.description: The key of the setting to retrieve. Available keys: model, systemPrompt, temperature, maxHistory, maxTokens.

args.name: userId
args.description: The ID of the user to retrieve the setting for. Defaults to author".

name: $aiResetGuildSettings
description: Reset all AI settings for the guild.

args.name: guildId
args.description: The ID of the guild to reset the settings for.

name: $aiResetUserSettings
description: Reset all AI settings for a user to defaults.

args.name: userId
args.description: The ID of the user to reset the settings for.

name: $aiSetChannelEnabled
description: Enable or disable AI responses in a specific channel.

args.name: enabled
args.description: Whether to enable or disable AI responses.

args.name: channelId
args.description: The ID of the channel to enable or disable AI responses for. Default: current channel.

args.name: guildId
args.description: The ID of the guild to enable or disable AI responses for. Default: current guild.

name: $aiSetChannelModel
description: Set the AI model for a specific channel.

args.name: model
args.description: The model to use for AI responses.

args.name: channelId
args.description: The ID of the channel to set the model for. Default: current channel.

args.name: guildId
args.description: The ID of the guild to set the model for. Default: current guild.

name: $aiSetChannelSystemPrompt
description: Set the system prompt for a specific channel.

args.name: prompt
args.description: The system prompt to use for AI responses.

args.name: channelId
args.description: The ID of the channel to set the system prompt for. Default: current channel.

args.name: guildId
args.description: The ID of the guild to set the system prompt for. Default: current guild.

name: $aiSetGuildMaxHistory
description: Set the max conversation history length for the guild.

args.name: maxHistory
args.description: The maximum number of conversation history entries to store for the guild.

args.name: guildId
args.description: The ID of the guild to set the max history for. Default: current guild.

name: $aiSetGuildModel
description: Set the default AI model for the guild.

args.name: model
args.description: The AI model to use for the guild. Example: openai:gpt-4o-mini

args.name: guildId
args.description: The ID of the guild to set the model for. Default: current guild.

name: $aiSetGuildSystemPrompt
description: Set the default system prompt for the guild.

args.name: prompt
args.description: The system prompt to use for AI responses.

args.name: guildId
args.description: The ID of the guild to set the system prompt for. Default: current guild.

name: $aiSetUserMaxHistory
description: Set the max conversation history length for a user.

args.name: maxHistory
args.description: The maximum number of conversation history entries to store for the user.

args.name: userId
args.description: The ID of the user to set the max history for. Default: current user.

name: $aiSetUserMaxTokens
description: Set the max tokens for a user.

args.name: maxTokens
args.description: The maximum number of tokens to use for AI responses.

args.name: userId
args.description: The ID of the user to set the max tokens for. Default: current user.

name: $aiSetUserModel
description: Set the default AI model for a user.

args.name: model
args.description: The AI model to use for the user. Example: openai:gpt-4o-mini

args.name: userId
args.description: The ID of the user to set the model for. Default: current user.

name: $aiSetUserSystemPrompt
description: Set a custom system prompt for a user.

args.name: prompt
args.description: The system prompt to use for AI responses.

args.name: userId
args.description: The ID of the user to set the system prompt for. Default: current user.

name: $aiSetUserTemperature
description: Set the default temperature (0-2) for a user.

args.name: temperature
args.description: The temperature to use for AI responses. Higher values make the AI more creative, while lower values make it more deterministic.

args.name: userId
args.description: The ID of the user to set the temperature for. Default: current user.
